paragraphs.text:
In general, spells are Arcane Skills
and may be found in books or
libraries, or be taught by friendly
witches. Some spells require a
Magic roll. For example, a spell may
require a L3 Magic roll, meaning
you must roll 3+ on d6 to
successfully perform the ritual. If
you have the Occultist Skill, you
have +1 to Magic rolls. If you have
the Occultist Skill (Expert), roll at +2.
